data.desc: Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers-including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, Square, and Under Armour-build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 in Product Analytics for 25 consecutive quarters in G2's Fall 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams.
